AI Button

AI-themed buttons with sparkle icons, gradient backgrounds, and glow animations for triggering AI-powered actions.

Primary Gradient

AI buttons with a gradient purple background and sparkle icon.

HTML
<button class="zak-ai-btn zak-ai-btn-primary zak-ai-btn-md">
    <svg class="zak-ai-sparkle" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor">
        <path d="M12 2l2.4 7.2L22 12l-7.6 2.8L12 22l-2.4-7.2L2 12l7.6-2.8z"/>
    </svg>
    Generate
</button>

Different visual styles for different contexts.

HTML
<button class="zak-ai-btn zak-ai-btn-primary zak-ai-btn-md">...Primary</button>
<button class="zak-ai-btn zak-ai-btn-secondary zak-ai-btn-md">...Secondary</button>
<button class="zak-ai-btn zak-ai-btn-outline zak-ai-btn-md">...Outline</button>
<button class="zak-ai-btn zak-ai-btn-ghost zak-ai-btn-md">...Ghost</button>

With AI Badge

HTML

    <svg class="zak-ai-sparkle" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor">...</svg>

</button>

Buttons with a pulsing glow animation to draw attention.

HTML

    <svg class="zak-ai-sparkle" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor">...</svg>

</button>

Loading State

AI buttons with a spinner during processing.

HTML
<button class="zak-ai-btn zak-ai-btn-loading zak-ai-btn-md">
    <span class="zak-ai-spinner"></span>Generating...
</button>

Icon Only

Compact icon-only AI buttons for toolbars and tight spaces.

HTML
<button class="zak-ai-btn zak-ai-btn-primary zak-ai-btn-icon" aria-label="AI Generate">
    <svg class="zak-ai-sparkle" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor">...</svg>
</button>

Button Group

Group multiple AI action buttons together.

HTML
<div style="display:flex;gap:0">
    <button class="zak-ai-btn zak-ai-btn-outline zak-ai-btn-md" style="border-radius:0.75rem 0 0 0.75rem">
        <svg class="zak-ai-sparkle" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor">...</svg>Generate
    </button>
    <button class="zak-ai-btn zak-ai-btn-primary zak-ai-btn-md" style="border-radius:0 0.75rem 0.75rem 0">Enhance</button>
</div>

CSS Classes

HTML
.zak-ai-btn                 /* Base AI button */
.zak-ai-btn-primary         /* Gradient purple background */
.zak-ai-btn-secondary       /* Light purple tint */
.zak-ai-btn-outline         /* Purple border, transparent bg */
.zak-ai-btn-ghost           /* No bg/border, text only */
.zak-ai-btn-glow            /* Pulsing glow animation */
.zak-ai-btn-loading         /* Loading state with spinner */
.zak-ai-btn-sm              /* Small */
.zak-ai-btn-md              /* Medium (default) */
.zak-ai-btn-lg              /* Large */
.zak-ai-btn-xl              /* Extra large */
.zak-ai-btn-icon            /* Square icon-only button */
.zak-ai-badge               /* "AI" badge inside button */
.zak-ai-sparkle             /* Sparkle icon sizing */
.zak-ai-spinner             /* Loading spinner circle */

/* Glow Animation Keyframes */
@keyframes zak-ai-glow {
    0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.4); }
    50%      { box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.6); }
}

/* Spinner Animation */
@keyframes zak-ai-spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }

JavaScript

Toggle loading state on click.

HTML
document.getElementById('ai-btn-demo').addEventListener('click', function() {
    const btn = this;
    btn.classList.remove('zak-ai-btn-primary');
    btn.classList.add('zak-ai-btn-loading');
    btn.innerHTML = '<span class="zak-ai-spinner"></span>Generating...';
    btn.disabled = true;
    setTimeout(() => {
        btn.classList.remove('zak-ai-btn-loading');
        btn.classList.add('zak-ai-btn-primary');
        btn.innerHTML = '<svg class="zak-ai-sparkle" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor"><path d="M12 2l2.4 7.2L22 12l-7.6 2.8L12 22l-2.4-7.2L2 12l7.6-2.8z"/></svg>Click to Test';
        btn.disabled = false;
    }, 2000);
});
